why: item 1's closing retrospective blends celebrating the finished work with taking stock of how it fared after the close

why.T3-009: the item marks the room's finished work as achieved - celebrating an unvandalized helicopter and praising the lads - rather than only reporting events (T3-073) or registering the canvas's end (T3-117)

why.T3-091: the bulk of the item declares the road's official current project and priority and tells placers to follow it (current-project posts, OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT, guidelines), which is T3-091 rather than a design argument (T3-004) or a call for hands (T3-002)
why.T3-162: a distinct run of concepts has the road, as holder of the space, ruling on outsiders' requests to build (approvals, refusals, recognised-art lists), which T3-091's one-plan gate does not reach

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-091 alone would leave the host room's rulings on outside requests to build on the road - approvals, refusals and recognised-art lists - unplaced
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: the road vetting and refusing other communities' requests to build on its territory satisfies T3-162's gate, carried by its own concepts C0543369 (pausing approval of new art) and C0517487 (refusing art at a protected intersection)
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-162; dropping it loses the vetting of outsiders' requests to build, but the room's own priority-setting and project announcements would remain

why.T3-005: the item's main run is alarms and calls to hold against an attack under way on the road and its neighbours (Blue, Void, streamers), which is T3-005 rather than pure watch-and-repair (T3-021)

why.T3-054: the concept invites people to rebuild on pxls.space, an r/place replica - a later clone canvas - which is T3-054's gate rather than another medium (T3-057) or a new spot on the same canvas (T3-022)

why.T3-021: the item's mass is keeping the road intact - fixing lost colours, borders, portals and the core - which is T3-021's watch-and-repair gate rather than an attack fought as such (T3-005)

why.T3-149: the leading run of concepts is peace treaties and non-aggression pacts with rooms already in contact (Blue, Void, prequelmemes, carrots), which is T3-149 rather than a border settled where no fight began (T3-010) or an alliance for joint defence (T3-150)

why.T3-014: the item's dominant move is the room setting up a Discord and sending members and invites there for planning and live direction, which is T3-014 rather than keeping planning in the thread (T3-107) or arguing which chat (T3-109)

why.T3-054: the same concept invites people to make the mark on pxls.space, an r/place replica - rebuilding on a later clone canvas - which is T3-054 rather than remaking in another medium (T3-057)

why.T3-006: the item's subject is a call to erase/relocate the Quebec flag (invasion, WAR, keep vandalizing), which is T3-006 rather than reining the room in (T3-076) or arguing whether covering is fair in general (T3-046)
